title: Model Utility Functions
summary: This module provides essential utility functions and base classes for managing model weights, optimizing model architectures through fusion, and defining interfaces for audio tokenization within the Transformers library.

nodes.label: Extract Model Weight Conversions
nodes.title: Extract Model Weight Conversions
nodes.description: Analyzes a `PreTrainedModel` to retrieve a list of specific weight conversion rules. It prioritizes class-specific mappings and falls back to general model type mappings, facilitating compatibility across different model versions or frameworks.

nodes.label: Define Patch Embedding Fusion
nodes.title: Patch Embeddings Fusion Specification
nodes.description: Defines the logic for fusing 3D convolutional patch embedding layers into more efficient linear projections. It includes criteria for identifying fusable modules and generates the necessary weight transformation operations for optimization.

nodes.label: Abstract Audio Tokenizer Interface
nodes.title: Abstract Audio Tokenizer Base
nodes.description: Provides an abstract base class for audio tokenizers, establishing a standard interface for encoding raw audio into discrete codebooks and decoding these codebooks back into raw audio. This ensures consistent audio processing capabilities.

nodes.label: PreTrained Model
nodes.title: Base PreTrained Model Class
nodes.description: A foundational class for all pre-trained models, providing common functionalities like loading, saving, and managing configurations. It serves as the base for various model architectures.

nodes.label: Weight Transformation Rules
nodes.title: Weight Transformation Rules
nodes.description: A data structure or mechanism defining how model weights should be converted or adapted, often used during model loading or conversion from different frameworks or versions.

nodes.label: Model Configuration
nodes.title: Model Configuration Object
nodes.description: An object holding the configuration parameters for a model, such as architecture details, hyperparameters, and other settings. It's crucial for initializing and understanding model behavior.

nodes.label: PyTorch Module
nodes.title: Generic PyTorch Neural Network Module
nodes.description: The base class for all neural network modules in PyTorch. Models subclass this class to define their computational graph, parameters, and forward pass logic.

nodes.label: PyTorch 3D Convolution
nodes.title: PyTorch 3D Convolutional Layer
nodes.description: A PyTorch module that applies a 3D convolutional operation over an input signal. It's used for processing volumetric data or sequences of images, extracting spatial and temporal features.

nodes.label: PyTorch Tensor
nodes.title: PyTorch Data Tensor
nodes.description: The fundamental data structure in PyTorch, similar to NumPy arrays, but with GPU acceleration capabilities. Tensors are used for storing and manipulating numerical data in deep learning models.

nodes.label: Feature Extractor
nodes.title: Data Feature Extractor
nodes.description: A component responsible for preprocessing raw input data (e.g., audio, images) into a format suitable for model input. This often involves normalization, resizing, or other domain-specific transformations.

groups.label: Analytical Utilities
groups.title: Model Analysis and Conversion
groups.description: Components focused on analyzing model structures and defining rules for weight conversions to ensure compatibility and proper loading.

groups.label: Architectural Optimization
groups.title: Model Architecture Optimization
groups.description: Utilities for defining and applying structural optimizations to model components, such as fusing layers for improved efficiency.

groups.label: Audio Data Interfaces
groups.title: Audio Data Processing Interfaces
groups.description: Abstract base classes that define standard interfaces for processing audio data, including encoding and decoding functionalities.
